notes.title: Infected – Full Release is Here! 🎮
notes.content:
[h1]Survivors, the wait is over! Infected has officially reached its final release and is now available for download on Steam!
Get ready to step into a harsh post-apocalyptic world where a deadly virus has transformed much of the population into terrifying infected zombies. You'll need every ounce of your skill, strategy, and firepower to survive.[/h1]

notes.title: PATCH FIX 02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Infected drop cash that player can pickup for later upcoming upgrades 
[*] Enemies now have hit reaction that slows them when they are hit
[*] Enemies accuricy is reduced
[*] Partial Controller support but still mouse and keyboard need
[*] New Weapon Revolver
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH FIX 01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Weapons not saving when die from thirst or hunger

[*] Hunger/Thirst interval reduced
[*] Loading screen Hints
[/list]

notes.title: Infected Demo Released
notes.content: [h1]We are thrilled to announce that the demo for our game Infected is now available on Steam! This is your chance to experience the world of Infected, where you'll battle against hordes of zombies and fight for your survival in a post-apocalyptic world.[/h1]
